operation.description:
MUTATING operation. Verify target and authorized intent; reconcile outcome before retry. Creates a leave application for a staff member. This is a v2 native-entity endpoint served from the `/v2/api/entity` base and authenticated with a Bearer token. The request body is a **flat JSON object** whose keys are the leave-application fields.

Always provide `staff_id`, `date_from`, `date_to` and `days`. The date range and day count must be consistent: `date_to` must equal `date_from + (days − 1)` (and be on or after `date_from`).

Which other fields are required depends on `type`:

| `type` | Meaning | Additionally required |
|---|---|---|
| `leave` (default) | Leave | `leave_type_id` |
| `half_leave` | Half (½) Leave | `leave_type_id` |
| `delay` | Late Arrival | `late_time` (minutes) |
| `early` | Early Leave | `early_time` (minutes) |

Do **not** send `id` (assigned automatically), `status` (always starts as `pending`), `approved_by`, `created_by` (taken from the authenticated user) or the approval-cycle fields (resolved automatically). On success the endpoint returns the standard native-entity `{ message, id }` envelope with the new leave-application id.

> Known issue (dev): the create pipeline currently faults and returns HTTP 500 `{"message":"Server Error"}` for this entity — see the audit report. The request contract below is the intended one.

staff_id.description: Required. Id of the staff member the leave is for. The caller must be allowed to apply leave for that staff member.

date_to.description: Required. Last day of leave, `YYYY-MM-DD`. Must be on or after `date_from` and equal to `date_from + (days − 1)`.

days.description: Required. Number of leave days requested.

type.description:
Optional. Kind of application. Defaults to `leave`.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| leave | Leave |
| half_leave | Half (½) Leave |
| delay | Late Arrival |
| early | Early Leave |

leave_type_id.description: Required when `type` is `leave` or `half_leave`. The configured leave type to use.

description.description: Optional. Free-text note stored on the application.

attachments.description: Optional. Uploaded files attached to the application (max 5 MB each).

200.description: The leave application was created; the standard native-entity `{ message, id }` envelope is returned with the new id.

id.description: Id of the created leave application.

400.description: The leave application could not be saved. On a validation failure the body is `{ "message": "Entity not saved", "errors": { … } }` with per-field messages in `errors` (a required field missing, or a field invalid for the chosen `type`); on a database save failure it is the `{ e, message, error }` envelope.

message.description: Failure summary — `Entity not saved` on a validation or save failure.

errors.description: Present on a validation failure: per-field messages keyed by field name (e.g. a missing `staff_id`/`date_from`/`date_to`/`days`, or a `leave_type_id` omitted for a `leave`/`half_leave` application).

e.description: Present on a database save failure: error detail object (or empty array).

error.description: Present on a database save failure: failure detail.

401.description: The Bearer token is missing, invalid, or expired.

500.description: Currently returned by the create pipeline for this entity on dev (`{"message":"Server Error"}`); no record is inserted. Recorded as a known issue in the audit report.
